title: Women’s Cricket World Cup Final 2025
metaDescription: India won the ICC Women’s Cricket World Cup 2025 final against South Africa at Navi Mumbai’s DY Patil Stadium.

overview.about: The Women's Cricket World Cup is the premier event in women's one-day international cricket, first held in 1973 - two years before the men's tournament even began. Australia are the overwhelmingly dominant side with seven titles, far ahead of England's four. The final on this page is scheduled for 2 November at the DY Patil Stadium in Navi Mumbai, India.
overview.nextEvent: The final is scheduled for 2 November 2026 at the DY Patil Stadium in Navi Mumbai. The Women's World Cup has grown rapidly in profile, prize money and crowds, and Australia go in as the team to beat after years of dominance.
